title: Implement the V4 P9.4 evidence viewer and read-only Plan Center
goal: Add Host-projected structured run/evidence inspection and safe read-only V4-native and V3-historical Plan presentation without introducing a second integrity or verdict authority.
acceptanceCriteria: Active-Target runs and evidence are selected only by validated Host-derived IDs and returned from P9.2 query projections unchanged.
Findings, coverage, modules, evidence files, authority hashes and raw Host JSON are presented without status reinterpretation.
Plan catalogs preserve Host classification, validation mode and hashes; browser requests select a Plan ID and never a path.
Plan detail bytes are confined beneath the active Target, link-free, size-bounded, strict UTF-8 and hash-matched to the Host catalog.
Markdown is rendered with text-only DOM construction and cannot execute HTML, links, images, scripts or event attributes.
V4-native Plans and V3-historical compatibility views are visibly and semantically distinct.
Windows and pinned network-disabled Linux tests prove read-only roots and preserve the P9.3 Stage Runner.
No P9.5 work, edit flow, Target mutation, reset, Git/PR action, remote access or remote activation is introduced.
